videos.caption: Which Bubble products are safe for tween & teen skin? Let’s discuss. 🌿⁠ While I don't love the line in general, I know your kiddos want it so let's get into it. ⁠ ⁠ When it comes to skincare for tweens and teens, simplicity is key. Here’s the breakdown:⁠ ⁠ 🧼 Cleansers: Fresh Start Gel Cleanser - Yes! ⁠ ⁠ 🧴 Moisturizers: Slam Dunk & Cloud Surf Good choices. Level Up, ok but better for better for oily or acne prone. ⁠ ⁠ Face Oils: Float On ehhhhh, NOT needed and not great for acne prone skin.💧⁠ ⁠ 💦 Toners: BreakEven Toner - A hard no. Teen skin needs gentleness, not harshness. 🚫⁠  ⁠ 💧 Serums: Hydrating Recovery Oil - Okay if dry. Hydrating Serum - Okay but not always needed. Clarifying Serum - Good for breakouts. Brightening Serum - NO, more for adults.⁠ ⁠ ⁠ Remember, simplicity and the right products are key for healthy tween and teen skin! 💧✨ #TeenSkincare #TweenSkincare #SkincareTips #SkincareRoutine #SkincareForBeginners #healthyskin
